title: Why it sucks being the assistant coach (feat. Aaron)

scenes.text: Why it sucks being the assistant coach.
Day one. The head coach says: "You'll help with tactics." You carry the water bottles.
Training. You set up forty cones for the perfect drill. The coach says: "Actually... let's just play a match."
Match day. You have a great idea. You tell the coach. He says no. Ten minutes later, he shouts the same idea. Everyone claps for him.
Half-time. The head coach gives the big speech. You hold the tactics board.
The coach is sick. You're in charge for one game! You lose 1-0. Group chat: "Bring the real coach back."
Cup final. You win! The coach gives the interview. You pick up the bibs.
That's the thing about being the assistant coach. Good idea? His. Bad result? Yours.
Shout-out to Aaron, the best helper coach. Tag yours below.
